title: Cool app but....
body: Love the idea, the only thing is the widget doesn't update automatically when the day pass, I have to refresh manually inside the app.

title: Too much
body:
Cool idea, horrible design, really annoying Ux/UI.
You want to complete tasks easily, this has too many steps and pages an buttons for a simple action.
